if (Test-Path $out) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $out }

function Crop($path, $prefix, $w, $h, $chunk) {
  $src = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($path)
  $i = 0; $y = 0
  while ($y -lt $h) {
    $ch = [Math]::Min($chunk, $h - $y)
    $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap($w, $ch)
    $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
    $g.DrawImage($src, (New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(0,0,$w,$ch)), (New-Object System.Drawing.Rectangle(0,$y,$w,$ch)), [System.Drawing.GraphicsUnit]::Pixel)
    $g.Dispose()
    $bmp.Save("$out\$prefix-$i.png", [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
    $bmp.Dispose()
    $i++; $y += $ch
  }
  $src.Dispose()
}
